content:
Carmen: Quick check — need to give an external contractor's service account read-only access to LLM traces/logs in projects/rdw-analytics for a debug window tomorrow (~2h). What is the minimal role and the recommended way to make it time-limited?
Raj: Minimal role is roles/logging.viewer at the project level if they only need to read logs. If they must impersonate an SA to call internal APIs, then also add roles/iam.serviceAccountUser scoped to the target SA.
Eli: Recommend doing a project-scoped binding (do NOT grant at org/folder). For time-limited access either: 1) use IAM Conditions on the binding with an expiration expression, or 2) create a short-lived impersonation flow (impersonate a temp SA and issue short-lived tokens).
Raj: Example IAM binding (gcloud) we can use, then revoke after 2h:
```
# grant logging.viewer with an IAM Condition to limit to rdw-analytics project
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding rdw-analytics \
  --member='user:contractor@example.com' \
  --role='roles/logging.viewer' \
  --condition='expression=resource.project=="rdw-analytics",title=tmp-debug,description="2h access for contractor"'
```
Eli: If they need Console UI access to view logs, also add roles/browser (very limited) so the console works, but avoid broad viewer on the project.
sec-bot: Note: logs may contain PII. Before granting, ensure compliance sign-off and redaction plan. Add redaction ticket and set DLP retention/filters if needed.
Carmen: OK — compliance check queued. Raj, can you create the binding with a condition for 2h and paste the policy diff here? I will confirm after compliance sign-off.
Raj: Will do. Creating binding in ~15m and will post the policy diff. cc @oncall-sre :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: If they will download/export logs, we should prevent that. Ideally provide an API-only path and monitor log export sinks. If console download is required, we need stricter review.
Eli: I can scan the affected log streams pre-grant and flag PII. If any redaction needed we'll redact before access.
Carmen: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Raj: Binding created and policy diff below (applied at 2123456900). Revoke set for +2h. :white_check_mark:
```
(Policy diff pasted into console)
```
Carmen: Got it — closing once revoke confirmed. :memo:
